name: Kcho
note: Real name Alexis Leyva Machado (also spelled Leiva). Born Nueva Gerona, Isla de la Juventud; one source (Calder) gives 1969.

name: Charl Landvreugd
note: Born Paramaribo; Dutch-Surinamese. Sources indicate a role as Head of Research & Curatorial Practice at Stedelijk Museum Amsterdam (date unconfirmed), so Amsterdam may also be a base.

name: Marc Latamie
note: Moved to New York in 1987 after Villa Medici Hors-les-Murs award; current residence not explicitly confirmed in results. Included in Caribbean Crossroads of the World (PAMM). Americas Society show 2012.

name: O'Neil Lawrence
note: Photographer, curator and writer; Chief Curator at the National Gallery of Jamaica (since 2008 at the gallery). Kingston inferred from NGJ post and Mutual Gallery show. Birth year not found.

name: Jaime Lee Loy
note: Result page is ~2008 and spells name 'Jamie Lee Loy'; Trinidad-based artist and writer (video, photography, installation, performance). Birth year not found; residence city not given.

name: Dubréus Lhérisson
note: Born Cap-Haïtien; raised in Bel Air, Port-au-Prince; sequined Vodou-inspired sculptor/flag-maker rather than painter; studio in Léogâne (date of move unclear). Shown at 12th Berlin Biennale. Spelled also Dubreus Lherisson / Debreus Lherisson.

name: Daniel Lind-Ramos
note: MacArthur Fellow 2021; professor at University of Puerto Rico, Humacao. Figura de Poder dated 2016-2020.

name: Hew Locke
origin_country: United Kingdom (born Edinburgh; raised in Guyana)
note: Royal Academician 2022; OBE 2023. Lived in Georgetown, Guyana from 1966.

name: Marcos Lora Read
note: City not stated in results. Official site loraread.com. Capsul shown at Venice Biennale via Kreyol Factory (2009).

name: Che Lovelace
residence: Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
note: Recent solo shows: 'Where The I Settles' (Nicola Vassell, New York, 2025), 'Day Always Comes' (Corvi-Mora, London, 2023). Chevalier, Ordre des Arts et des Lettres 2025. Lectures at UWI. Birthplace given as San Fernando or Port of Spain.

name: Miguel Luciano
note: Born San Juan, Puerto Rico, 5 March 1972. A Coronado Print Studio page about a Dominican-born Miguel Luciano (b.1968) appears to be a different person.

name: Shastri Maharaj
note: Painter; UWI graduate (also Winnipeg/Manitoba); per 1999 UWI archive record lives, paints and teaches in central Trinidad. Birth year not found; record is dated, so current status unconfirmed.

name: Pauline Marcelle
note: Born 21 July 1964 in Calibishie; MFA University of Applied Arts Vienna. Bend Down Boutique is a painting series 2008-2016.

name: Tessa Mars
note: Born Port-au-Prince. Sources conflict: one says currently resides in Puerto Rico (Rijksakademie alumna 2020-2022); a more recent page says lives and works in Port-au-Prince. Solo show 'Nan dòmi: Las canciones que cantamos', Casa del Lago, Mexico City, May 2024.

name: Olivia McGilchrist
note: Jamaican-French artist and videographer, born in Europe; moved back to Jamaica (per Tatler Asia interview, Davidoff Art Initiative, Art Basel Hong Kong). Birth year and city not found.

name: Pierre Pascal "Pasko" Merisier
note: Born Pétion-Ville. Africanah says he now lives in France; a 2025 Visit Haiti profile calls him printmaking instructor at the Centre d'Art, Haiti. Unresolved.

name: Joiri Minaya
origin_country: Dominican Republic (born New York, raised in DR)
note: Born NYC 1990; based in Manhattan with strong presence in the Dominican Republic. Joan Mitchell Emerging Artist Grant.

name: Ibrahim Miranda
note: Born Pinar del Río. Known for maps of Cuba as a base; held by MoMA and NGA Washington.

name: Madsen Mompremier
note: Born Gonaïves, 12 Aug 1952 (Spencer Museum); moved to Port-au-Prince 1972; known for Vodou lwa paintings. Current residence not shown in results.

name: Arnaldo Morales
note: Born Ponce; based in New York since 1996; mechanical/kinetic sculptor. Shown MoMA PS1, El Museo del Barrio; Joan Mitchell and NYFA fellowships.
